reviews.modifierGrammarAssessment: The headings supply 天機 and 巨門 as subjects. 巨門同勞力欠安 and reciprocal 天機同心忙不安 are coordinate co-presence branches with their own predicates. Later 加羊陀火鈴空劫 introduces an added-condition clause; it may qualify the paragraph broadly but does not grammatically turn the preceding quotation into a claim restricted to absence of adverse stars. The two complete paragraphs are retained. This is support for reporting what those baseline textual branches say, expressly leaving the added-condition branches unevaluated; it is not support for a final chart judgment under those modifiers. No 無殺, 不見, brightness, or 卯/酉 restriction appears in these two cohost clauses. Other Juan2 passages expressly write such qualifiers where intended; the distinct 官祿 and 田宅 卯/酉 wording cannot be transferred.
reviews.wordingAssessment: Exact Vietnamese wording is supported as an internally attributed textual paraphrase. 勞力 supports lao lực; 心忙 supports lòng bận bịu; 欠安 and 不安 support chưa yên in this contextual imagery. It quotes both Chinese phrases, limits itself to these two entries of this transcription, and expressly disclaims personality or health confirmation and unevaluated gia sát conditions. It does not assert observed traits, health, lifespan, wealth, grade or life events.
reviews.scopeAssessment: MATCH applies only to exact same_palace phuc_duc with both named stars and the exact baseline-only wording/limitations. Both Mão and Dậu, with or without four directly hosted named adverse stars, may retrieve this annotation. Without those four is not a clean or favorable chart. 空劫 aliases and all added-adverse consequences remain unevaluated, not false. TPTC-only presence and a pair in another palace do not satisfy 同 in this branch.
